messages:
Ana: Heads-up — cutoff in ~8h for v0.23. We need final signoffs: version bump PRs, changelog sanity, QA smoke, and security checklist. Who can own which item? @channel

Liam: I can own the version bump PRs. PR #4873 is WIP, pushing fixes now. ETA ~30m.

Kate: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4873
branch: release/v0.23 -> main
files: package.json, build.gradle, CHANGELOG.md
small tweak to telemetry flag only.

QA-ops: Kicking off smoke suite on staging once Liam merges. Currently one flaky test in tokenizer-edgecase that sometimes times out — will triage but might need a quick patch.

Liam: Rebased and pushed. CI passed except the lint job (minor). Fixing lint quick.

docs-jenny: Docs PR is ready and points to the new endpoint path. PR #4878. I'll hold merge until version bump lands so links don't break.

Sec: Quick security pass completed. No secrets in the diff. One dependency flagged by audit: libcurl -> needs patch to 7.86.1 (low severity). Recommend merging security patch separately before GA or add a rollback plan.

Ana: Ok — plan: Liam merges bump, Kate confirms changelog final, docs-jenny merges docs after bump, QA-ops verifies smoke, Sec files the dep patch PR (or we cherry-pick). Srini, can you own canary rollout?

Srini: I can run canary at 16:30 PT and monitor latency/cost metrics. Will keep a 30m window and abort on >25% error or token latency P95 regression.

QA-ops: Smoke run showing 1 failing test (tokenizer-edgecase) — root cause seems nondet seed on the fixture; I can land a tiny test-fix and re-run. ETA 20m.

Liam: Lint fixed, merging bump now.

DeployBot: merge succeeded: commit d4c3b2a -> main (by Liam)

Kate: Changelog updated and pushed. Double-checked release notes, removed a deprecated flag mention.

docs-jenny: Merging docs now. Links point to /v0.23 endpoints.

Sec: Opening PR #4880 to bump libcurl to 7.86.1. Marked as target "post-cutoff-hotfix" if we can't get it in before GA.

Srini: Canary running. Initial metrics look good. No increased error rate, tail latency stable. Continuing monitoring.

QA-ops: Re-run passed after test-fix. All smoke checks green.

Ana: Great — final checklist: 1) version bump merged (done), 2) changelog updated (done), 3) docs merged (done), 4) QA smoke (green), 5) sec patch PR open (tracked). Proceeding with release window at 18:00 PT. If anyone sees regressions, ping me and @srini immediately. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: scheduled rollout at 18:00 PT. Canary status: healthy.

Srini: I'll keep the rollback ready and signal within the window if anything looks off.

Ana: Thanks all — will post post-cutover notes in #eng-releases after GA.

Liam: Nice work team.

Kate: :party-parrot:
